# Cover Letter

[Your name]
[Your address]
[Your email and telephone]

[Date]

**Dear Hiring Manager**

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Community Engagement Officer position at Riverbank Libraries Trust. As someone who has spent the past five years developing community programmes and managing volunteer teams across Rotherham and Sheffield, I am excited by the prospect of bringing these skills to support your libraries' mission of genuine community engagement.

My current role as Volunteer Coordinator has given me extensive experience in the volunteer management that is central to this position. I recruit, induct and support approximately sixty volunteers across four distribution centres, delivering comprehensive safeguarding and training programmes for all of them. This experience has taught me how to build diverse, motivated teams and create robust systems that ensure both volunteer satisfaction and organisational accountability. I am confident I can support and develop your team of forty volunteers effectively.

My background in events and public programming is equally relevant. During my two years as an Events Assistant at an independent Sheffield theatre, I designed and delivered varied programmes including schools outreach activities and monthly community open days. This gave me direct experience of engaging different audiences and understanding how to make cultural and community spaces genuinely welcoming. I am particularly familiar with schools partnerships, having worked with several of the primary schools mentioned on your Trust's website.

I have proven capability in financial management and reporting. I currently manage an annual budget of approximately £12,000 for volunteer expenses and training, and I produce detailed monthly reports for our trustees covering participation data, volunteer retention and impact. Whilst a budget of £48,000 would represent an increase in scale, my experience demonstrates the reliability and care I bring to financial stewardship. Last year, I contributed significantly to a successful £25,000 National Lottery Community Fund application, gathering participation data and case studies that evidenced our community impact—skills directly transferable to supporting your funding applications.

I am committed to reducing barriers to participation and ensuring that libraries serve all communities, particularly those currently under-represented. Growing up in Sheffield and continuing to live here, I understand the area and its diverse communities deeply. My passion for public access to resources and community wellbeing has been demonstrated consistently across my work in both cultural and social sectors.

I am enthusiastic about working occasional evenings and weekends, and I look forward to contributing to Riverbank Libraries' vital work.

Yours faithfully

[Your name]
